annotations.text:
Anything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder waiting on the real deal:

client and project name, usage (media / territory / term), dates, week ranges, day counts, day rate, totals, delivery formats and the proposal reference.

The week ranges on page 04 also set the width of the phase bar above them (flex-grow 2:3:3:2) — change both together or the bar stops matching the schedule.

Everything else — approach, deliverables, terms, studio details — is Forma's own and can ship as written.

Pages are A4 (794 x 1123 at 96dpi). Export PDF gives one page per artboard, in canvas order.
